rationale: Micah's work on visual intuition for machine learning and interactive data visualization directly complements Arya's agentic AI tooling—Arya's agent-first systems need intuitive interfaces to be usable, and Micah's conviction that interactive visualization is the key interface between AI and human decision-making maps onto building better control surfaces for AI agents. Both are SF-based founders experimenting in underexplored ML tooling spaces, with complementary skills (Micah's d3.js and design practice + Arya's typescript/rust/pytorch backend work) that could unlock more human-focused agentic products.
intro_message: Micah Stubbs, meet Arya Teja Rudraraju—you're both building next-generation AI interfaces (Micah on visual ML intuition, Arya on agentic agent control), and your skill sets and convictions complement each other's work.
